what: Proposed wait line discards the writer exit status
scenario_or_breakage: breadcrumb-monitor exits 0 for non-timeout outcomes and wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true also leaves the wrapper successful, so ship-pr.sh exits like 3 or 5 can be hidden and Step 8 cannot branch correctly
suggested_fix: Capture wait status or read LARCH_STATUS_FILE after the monitor, then emit or propagate a stable writer exit code; update SKILL parse instructions and tests around that contract

what: PID capture window is too narrow for existing multiline writer invocations
scenario_or_breakage: The plan requires <IDENT>=$! within 3 nonblank lines of the anchor line, but ship-pr.sh and several collect-agent-results.sh blocks span more lines before the command ends, causing the new lint rule to fail canonical rewritten fences
suggested_fix: Define the capture check relative to the end of the merged continuation command, or allow capture immediately after the command terminator; add a long multiline ship-pr.sh fixture

what: Plan omits linter-scanned shared Markdown pair fences from the sweep
scenario_or_breakage: scripts/lint-foreground-markers.sh scans skills/shared/*.md, so enabling the new wait invariant will either fail make lint-foreground-markers on these existing collect-agent-results.sh fences or leave shared copyable docs with the orphan-prone shape
suggested_fix: Add a skills/shared/*.md sweep to the plan, at minimum updating external-reviewers.md and dialectic-protocol.md

what: Regression harness simulates the wrong process lifetime
scenario_or_breakage: A fake writer that backgrounds sleep 5 and then exits cannot be coupled by wait "$writer_pid"; the wrapper waits only for the writer shell, not its orphaned grandchild, so the positive case either fails or validates the wrong behavior
suggested_fix: Make the fake writer write the done sentinel and then sleep in the foreground in the same writer process; keep a no-wait negative control and prefer marker-file completion over tight elapsed-time assertions
